title: Pullback of scalar-compatible quotient diagrams
statement: Let ell be prime, g:Yprime→Y a morphism of Noetherian schemes, family and familyprime the two coefficient Families of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams], and E a finite subextension. Suppose their integral E diagrams have PullbackCompatibility using the specified integral root comparisons. For every uniformizer pi and n≥0, and every pair of diagrams over O_E/(pi^(n+1)) with the ScalarCompatibility squares from the two integral E diagrams, there are maps mP,mW satisfying QuotientPullMap of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-family-pullback] and PullbackCompatibility for these two quotient diagrams. No completed class, Reference, base field, or choice of Cartier arrow is required.

proof.text: Apply diagonalQuotient_sourcePullback to integral.sourceData, obtaining the two normalized tensor maps and the quotient ordinary source data s.
Apply diagonalQuotient_classPullback to the integral compatibility and the two given scalar compatibilities, using the maps and s just obtained. This gives exactly the delta field.

Apply diagonalQuotient_tracePullback to obtain the q, p1 and p2 trace fields, including exchange invertibility from the supplied scalar comparison_iso fields. Assemble PullbackCompatibility with sourceData=s and these four proven fields. The original uniformizer hypothesis is retained in the signature but is not needed by this argument.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (3), coefficient functors commuting with geometric pullback; quotient-base-change refinement of paragraph (3)
proof_origin.note: Lean assembly of three strict constituents: ordinary source, class square, trace squares. No component repeats the original existential compatibility statement.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the published universal-property API for the canonical derived model.

mathlib_searches.query: A cone of root projections followed by free module units induces a map into the inverse limit of integral Tate twists. Coefficient quotient by a regular element commutes with geometric pullback and direct image.
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits concerning adic-completion projections, perfectoid untilts, and inverse limits; no diagonal root-cone or scalar/pullback compatibility theorem.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the ordinary limit universal property and the existing free-module adjunction.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including isLimitOfPreserves and preserves_lift_mapCone. isLimitOfPreserves gives exactly the underlying-module limit used by the root map.

theorem diagonalCoefficient_quotientBaseChange
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Y']
    (family : Family l Y) (family' : Family l Y')
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (integral : PullbackCompatibility (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1) g
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (family.integral E) (family'.integral E)
      (spIntegralComparison (baseP g) l E) (spIntegralComparison (baseW g) l E))
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (_hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y (quotientLine l E π n))
    (d' : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y' (quotientLine l E π n)) :
    ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) (family.integral E) d →
    ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y'
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) (family'.integral E) d' →
    ∃ (mP : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseP g)).obj
        (quotientLine l E π n (ProjectiveLine Y)).X ⟶
          (quotientLine l E π n (ProjectiveLine Y')).X)
      (mW : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (baseW g)).obj
        (quotientLine l E π n (diagonalSurface Y)).X ⟶
          (quotientLine l E π n (diagonalSurface Y')).X),
      QuotientPullMap l E π n (baseP g) mP ∧ QuotientPullMap l E π n (baseW g) mW ∧
        Nonempty (PullbackCompatibility
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n)) g
          (quotientLine l E π n) d d' mP mW)
